title: Thy Utilities
description: Tweaks minecraft's vanilla textures for better understanding
body:
# **_REQUIRES OPTIFINE OR MOREMCMETA EMISSIVE TEXTURES_**

Tweaks the game's vanilla textures, so you could see some things clearer. Examples: blue glowing netherite, clear glass and water, clear bow/crossbow pull progress, edited HUD and break texture. (see below and in the gallery)
